SELECT region_type AS regionType, region_id AS regionId, vet_account_id AS vetAccountId, configured_by AS configuredBy FROM cage_region_vet WHERE region_type = #{regionType} AND region_id = #{regionId} ORDER BY vet_account_id ASC
